desc: Edit only the eyes and mouth of this hamster. Keep everything else the same: pixel texture, outline, ears, paws, gem, body, colors, and keep the purple gem in its paws. Eyes: small round dark eyes about 3 to 4 pixels wide with a single 1px white highlight, slightly glossy, calm and innocent, like a small otter sprite. No eyebrows, no narrowed or sly eyes, no smirk. Mouth: a natural short mouth line fitting a hamster, clearly visible, no big smile.
